load_indexed_dataset: load a fairseq indexed dataset from a data-bin path using a dictionary and optional combine flag
batch_by_size: yield mini-batches of dataset indices bucketed by token count with max tokens and sentences limits
collate_tokens: convert a list of 1d tensors into a padded 2d tensor with optional left padding and eos handling
filter_by_size: filter dataset indices by size using a size function and max positions tuple with optional exception raising
process_bpe_symbol: process and remove BPE symbols from a sentence string supporting sentencepiece and custom BPE markers
